		Overview
	

The complete archive of Hitdarderut Haaretz (התדרדרות הארץ), a Hebrew-language intellectual and literary website associated with the philosophical writings of the Netanya School (אסכולת נתניה).
The collection brings together philosophical essays, speculative thought, literary works, cultural criticism, and reflections on artificial intelligence and the future of human and non-human intelligence.… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Ben-Zippor/philosophy-ai-era-netanya-school-complete-archive.
